Find the perfect order of a distinct set of symbols to operate the system at its best!

Depending on the order is the system's performance.
Each symbol can only be present once in the output sequence.

The symbols with their performance properties:
A = yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol
B = yields best performance if not preceded by symbol A or C
C = yields best performance when not being the last symbol
D = yields best performance when being the first symbol

No explanations. Final answer only!

The optimal order for the system is: DABC.

Explanation:

* D starts the sequence as it performs best when being the first symbol.
* A follows D as it performs best when not preceded by more than one symbol.
* B comes next as it performs best when not preceded by symbol A or C.
* C ends the sequence as it performs best when not being the last symbol.
